I answered Tobias in a thread on his message. The ticket is #8841. He flagged it himself in #central-random yesterday (13 Oct, 09:27), saying West yard Door 2 was still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk.

That message calls it "Tobias's dealer account" and doesn't name Marrow Fieldworks. A team handoff note says Marrow Fieldworks moved to him on 5 Jan, so it's very likely the same account, and I told him that in the reply.

Everything I used is in places Tobias can see: a channel he's in and a team note anyone can read. I didn't bring up the ticket number he guessed in his private message to me. It was only a guess, and he asked me to keep it to myself.
